candidates: When editing markdown table rows in the documentation, avoid extra trailing or internal spaces inside cells — misaligned pipe characters or extraneous whitespace can silently break table rendering. Verify that spacing is consistent across every row in the affected table before approving.

When writing or reviewing description text for entries inside a documentation table that already belongs to a named section (e.g., the themeVariables table in `docs/config/theming.md`), do not add self-referential phrases like 'can be customized via `themeVariables`' — the surrounding section heading already provides that context, and restating it adds redundant noise to the description.
